purpose: Prevent derived metric, propagation, scalar-readout, embedding, optimization, or continuum structure from being silently promoted to the Enterprise Math native/base ontology.
core_rule: A claim may be labeled NATIVE/INTRINSIC/BASE-WORLD only when every theorem-critical object and operator is already in the declared native substrate, or has an explicit definability certificate from that substrate. Otherwise the claim must be typed as conditional/derived/readout/continuum rather than native.

I0_IMPLEMENTATION_CARRIER.meaning: Coordinates, labels, bases, embeddings, or encodings used to implement/check a declared native relation. They are not ontology merely because the implementation uses them.
examples: integer lattice coordinates used only to realize contact adjacency

N0_NATIVE_RELATIONAL.meaning: Only the explicitly declared carrier, local relations, state predicates, and operations that belong to the task's base world before any additional choice/readout is made.
examples: contact cut relative to an occupied cluster

N1_DERIVED_OPERATIONAL_SEMANTICS.meaning: A chosen process, ordering, root/event, optimization rule, propagation rule, path rule, time rule, stochastic kernel, or other operation layered on N0.
examples: choose a root or seed as center

N2_READOUT_COLLAPSE.meaning: A quotient, scalarization, aggregate, coordinate-dependent geometric quantity, spectral/moment observable, or other readout of N0/N1 structure.

N3_CONTINUUM_CLASSICAL.meaning: Continuum/Euclidean/smooth/PDE/integral language applied after additional completion or coarse description.

admissibility_rules.rule: Every theorem-critical symbol/operator in a claim labeled native/intrinsic/base-world must appear in the declared N0 substrate or be eliminated by an explicit definability certificate.

A derived object may be promoted toward N0 only after proving construction from N0, independence from arbitrary choices/coordinates, and invariance under the allowed N0 relabelings/automorphisms relevant to the claim. Convenience, symmetry intuition, or uniqueness in one embedding is insufficient.
Words such as natural, canonical, intrinsic, obvious, nearest, radial, symmetric, isotropic, or physical do not establish native admissibility.
A mathematically correct result using N1/N2/N3 structure is not discarded. Reclassify it as CONDITIONAL_ON_DECLARED_SEMANTICS / READOUT_ONLY / CONTINUUM_ONLY and state the dependency explicitly.

Equal-distance, radius, shell, sphere, or ball predicates are ill-typed at N0 unless a metric/equidistance structure is itself explicitly part of N0 or has passed NSA-02. A graph admits a definable shortest-path metric only after shortest-path semantics has been selected; that does not make the metric an N0 primitive.
A seed cell/root used to construct or enumerate states is provenance unless a separate semantics promotes it. It must not silently become a global center/radial coordinate.

Implementation coordinates may be used to compute/check contact relations, but Euclidean length, angle, covariance, normal, area, point-group orientation, or other embedding-dependent quantities are N2 unless the embedding is explicitly declared as additional semantics.
A shape obtained by minimizing/maximizing a native quantity is exact conditional mathematics of that optimization semantics, not automatically the native shape of the world.
Finite/infinite status is orthogonal to native/derived status. An infinite discrete completion built after a metricization/readout remains conditional on that metricization/readout.
A standard/classical definition or prior-art theorem may be used conditionally but does not become part of the Enterprise Math base merely because it is conventional mathematics.
For collapse/precision claims, declare the future language and carrier separately from the base ontology. A representation can be exact for a future language without being a native state descriptor.

applies_when: task compares Enterprise Math base to imported classical structure
task introduces a new geometry/metric/propagation/readout primitive

mandatory_regressions.expected_typing: shortest-path/word-metric N1 followed by shell/ball N2; formulas may remain exact conditional mathematics but are not propagation-independent N0 ontology
propagation kernel N1; physical-coordinate covariance/Bloch/moment readouts N2 unless additional embedding semantics is declared
root + graph distance N1, radial scalarization and zeta aggregate N2; cannot kill a stronger metric-free N0 hypothesis
contact cut relative to an occupied cluster is N0-relational; scalar S, local-type quotient, isoperimetric optimization and asymptotic Wulff/zonotope are later strata
operation-horizon layers and B_h/M_h are N1/future-language carriers, not N0 ontology even when exact

retroactive_policy.required_action: Retype old claims under this gate. Recompute only when theorem-critical conclusions depended on an inadmissible primitive or an invalid promotion between strata.
